name: Gelateria Tomaselli
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gelateria Tomaselli in Tirol!**

Indulge in the finest handcrafted gelato in the heart of the Alps. Our authentic Italian recipes bring you creamy, rich flavors like **Stracciatella**, **Pistachio**, and **Hazelnut**, all made with the freshest ingredients.

Located in **Innsbruck**, just a short stroll from the **Goldenes Dachl**, our cozy gelateria is the perfect stop for a sweet treat after exploring the city’s historic charm. Whether you’re craving a classic **Vanilla** or a seasonal specialty like **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** gelato, every scoop is a taste of tradition and quality.

Visit us at **Maria-Theresien-Straße 34** and let your taste buds travel to Italy—right here in the mountains of **Tirol**!
